hooks.text: An asteroid sample was so huge it jammed its own lid.
Why did collecting too much asteroid rock threaten a NASA mission?
A record-shattering asteroid sample jammed the probe's lid open.

title: The Asteroid Sample That Was Too Successful
description: OSIRIS-REx grabbed so much of asteroid Bennu that rocks jammed its lid open and pieces drifted off into space.

beats.text: An asteroid sample was so huge it jammed its own lid.
beats.visual: artist concept of OSIRIS-REx spacecraft near asteroid Bennu, NASA, 2020

beats.text: In October 2020, NASA's OSIRIS-REx probe touched down on asteroid Bennu to collect a surface sample.
beats.visual: photograph of OSIRIS-REx TAGSAM arm touching asteroid Bennu surface, NASA, 2020

beats.text: A burst of nitrogen gas stirred up material, but the probe scooped up way too much.
beats.visual: animation still of OSIRIS-REx nitrogen gas burst on asteroid Bennu, NASA, 2020
queries: Asteroid Bennu sample in TAGSAM head NASA

beats.text: Large rocks jammed the collector's mylar lid open, letting precious asteroid dust drift away into space.
beats.visual: photograph of OSIRIS-REx sample container with rocks overflowing, NASA, 2020
queries: OSIRIS-REx TAGSAM head rocks jammed mylar flap

beats.text: Fearing more loss, mission controllers canceled a planned weighing spin and rushed to secure the harvest.
beats.visual: photograph of mission control team during OSIRIS-REx operations, 2020

beats.text: On October 27, they successfully stowed the leaking sampler head inside the return capsule.
beats.visual: illustration of OSIRIS-REx sample return capsule stowing procedure, NASA, 2020

beats.text: Despite the leak, they recovered 121.6 grams, over double the original mission goal.
beats.visual: photograph of asteroid Bennu sample particles inside NASA clean room, 2023
queries: OSIRIS-REx sample first look NASA Johnson
Asteroid Bennu sample in TAGSAM head NASA

beats.text: This record-shattering haul nearly caused total mission failure.
beats.visual: photograph of OSIRIS-REx sample return capsule parachute landing in Utah, 2023
queries: OSIRIS-REx sample return capsule parachute Utah

better_than_last: Revised the final beats to include the requested narrative tension regarding mission failure and the double-goal recovery.
